Provider network — monthly all-hands.

REAL DATA, pulled 2 Sep 2026 via sql/network-deck-data.sql.

Pincodes are proven — a real order was fulfilled there. Claimed coverage would be roughly 6x higher and is not used anywhere in this deck.

Two things to settle before presenting:

1. PPMC is derived from active STAR-PPMC package pricing, not the isApiPpmc flag, which is unset on every lab. Prod also has a separate Star Health store (id 38) that is NOT counted here — confirm that is right.

2. Speciality names carry spelling variants (Orthopaedics / Orthopedics), which is why the count reads 232.

Pharmacy is still not tracked in Atlas at all.
